thread:
nora: Quick sync  we need a lightweight playbook for model deprecation + migration that ties into catalog onboarding. Sales already flagged two customers asking for a clear migration SLA. Thoughts?
ben: TL;DR: define stages (Deprecation Notice -> Migration Window -> Forced Swap), benches, comm templates, and migration credits. Keep it simple for GA.
diego: Agree. Proposed default windows: Notice = 60d, Migration Window = 30d, Forced Swap = day 91. Offer an extended migration add-on up to 180d.
tara: Bench triggers for requiring migration support: if new model improves perf by >8% or reduces cost by >20% we recommend customers migrate. But we need objective thresholds (latency, embedding drift, LL metric).
ben: Suggest concrete metrics: latency p95 delta <= 10ms improvement to count as non-essential; embedding cosine shift threshold 3% absolute; and a quality regression guard: if new model causes <95% of baseline accuracy on eval set, we flag.
nora: Ops: can we automate an evaluation job that compares pinned model -> candidate and outputs a migration score?
ops-bot: Eval pipeline job created: PIPELINE-774. Example command to run locally:
```
eval-run --base-model rwdx-3b:pin --candidate-model rwdx-4b --seq 512 --samples 250 --metrics latency,ppl,embed_cos
```
Outputs migration_score and per-metric deltas.
diego: Nice. Migration_score formula idea: weighted sum: 0.5*quality_delta + 0.3*latency_improve + 0.2*cost_improve; scale -> 0..100. Score >= 60 -> auto-suggest migration; score >= 80 -> recommend migration credits.
tara: UX: Console should show "migration suggestion" card with score, break down, and a one-click migrate (dry-run) that simulates traffic for 24h. Also allow customers to opt-out of automated suggestions.
nora: Comms: we need templates: notice email, migration plan, and post-migration verification. @comms can you draft simple templates?
comms: Will do. Drafts: short notice (60d), technical migration guide, rollback FAQ. I'll attach to the spec.
ben: Billing ask: export migration credits and pin metadata (pin_tier, expiry, pinned_by). Also need a dispute pathway if customer claims migration caused regression.
diego: For disputes, include an appeal pipeline: run golden eval and if discrepancy persists we open postmortem with SRE and ML. Recovery policy: either rollback, provide credits, or build a shim.
nora: Edge cases: third-party upstream model changes (weights changed) -> treat as emergency deprecate, immediate customer notification + 14d remediation window. Legal will need language.
ben: Implementation notes: catalog should add fields: deprecation_state (active, warned, migrating, retired), migration_score_history, upstream_change_flag.
tara: Canary plan: roll migrations to 5% traffic for 48h with telemetry: user_facing_error_rate, latency_p95, semantic-drift. If health OK, ramp.
ora: Owners & next steps: ben -> write spec draft with runbooks; diego -> implement eval pipeline changes; tara -> console mocks; comms -> templates. Target: spec draft before next sprint planning.
ops-bot: Ticket PROD-3421 created: "catalog deprecation + migration playbook" (owners: ben, diego, tara)
ben: Quick open question: should forced-swap (day 91) be hard or provide a paid bridge? I prefer paid bridge for enterprise customers.
nora: Paid bridge OK for enterprise only. Default behavior = auto-fallback to compatible variant, not hard redirect. We'll document.
comms: I'll add customer-facing copy for both standard and enterprise paths.
ben: Great. That should be enough to start the draft. Using this thread as the working notes. :rocket:
